answer: Re-attestations are stored in dawn and comet lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the voyage graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 210 impostors cost 1038 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
